title: Command Dispatch
statement: Implement `solve(cmd)`. `cmd` is a list. `["ping"]` returns `pong`. `["echo", text]` returns `text`. `["add", a, b]` returns the integer `a + b`. Any other first element returns the string `error`. Do not crash on an unknown command.
hints: echo returns the second element unchanged.
The default branch is the string error.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A command list is a tiny match subject.

editorial: A command list is a tiny match subject. Unknown commands are a result, not an IndexError and not a fall-through into add. Each arm reads only the fields that arm needs.
